tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text, headings, the date strip's first part. The brand's black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, captions. Passes 4.5:1 on ground and surface.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. White for attendee screens, the UR Pass and print; Night for usher and dashboard screens used in dark halls.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Soft panels and secondary fields on white, such as the pass-code box.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, form fields, the pass. On white, cards are set apart by a border.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines, field borders, dividers.

tokens.name: fire
tokens.usage: The brand red. Primary buttons, the time box, key highlights. Use large; for small red text on white use fire-ink.

tokens.name: fire-ink
tokens.usage: Red text on ground: venue names, the month in the date strip. About 6:1 on white.

tokens.name: on-fire
tokens.usage: Text on a fire fill.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The brand yellow. Shapes, tabs, stripes and the time in the date strip on dark grounds. Never text on white: it fails contrast.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text on a gold fill.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Warm orange light in imagery and illustrations only. Not for UI text or controls.

tokens.name: city-lagos
tokens.usage: Lagos city tab, wristbands and pass accent, matching the Lagos flyers. Pair with on-gold text.

tokens.name: city-abuja
tokens.usage: Abuja city tab, wristbands and pass accent, matching the Abuja flyers. Pair with on-fire text.

tokens.name: status-go
tokens.usage: Scanner result: checked in. Full-screen fill with white text.

tokens.name: status-check
tokens.usage: Scanner result: needs an usher's decision. Full-screen fill with ink text.

tokens.name: status-stop
tokens.usage: Scanner result: not found, and errors. Full-screen fill with white text.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero words, set in italic capitals, echoing the logo's slanted weight.

styles.name: strip
styles.usage: The date strip and venue line, in capitals with 0.08em letter-spacing. Set Archivo's width axis to 125.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrow labels in capitals with 0.12em letter-spacing.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; gaps between fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side padding; gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gaps between sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tabs, tags, small chips. The brand is sharp and bold, so corners stay tight.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The UR Pass card and large panels.
